caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher, central on a plain, tan-colored background. The pitcher has a translucent, greenish hue with a slightly bulbous body that tapers toward the base and a wide circular mouth with a small spout. Spiral ridges encircle the body diagonally from top to bottom. The handle is attached at the upper rim and curves downward, with decorative knobs at the attachment points. The handle matches the pitcher in color and translucency, and its ridges give it a textured appearance. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the overall composition is simple and centered.
title: Glass Pitcher
